stages.title: Ranker and Enricher, proven on 50 entries

done_check.instruments: sense-ranker.md, enricher.md, entry-reader.md in .claude/agents/, versioned like census-reader/family-author; null-auditor.md added for stage 5
done_check.gate: tools/enrich_validate.py: a ranking is accepted only as a permutation of the offered synset ids (50/50 both runs); a written sense only with a learner line, headword-bearing examples, listed labels and a null-or-candidate verdict (50/50 both runs); tools/entry_validate.py clean on the batch (gloss unchanged)
done_check.measured_enrich_001: 50 entries, 136 senses; 7.4% of senses wrong (10), 2/50 rankings wrong; ~20,600 tokens/entry incl. read via general-purpose agents - OVER the 5% gate; both rubrics fixed (example fits a neighbouring sense; 'or' glosses narrowed; unattested first sense)
done_check.measured_enrich_002: same 50, 132 senses under the fixed rubrics; 3.8% of senses wrong (5), 2/50 rankings wrong (make, time); ~12,000 tokens/entry incl. read, ~5,500 without, by-name agents - UNDER the gate; new baseline
done_check.candidates: 1 of 132 senses sent to the family path (lady, woman of refinement); 131 null -> stage 5
done_check.repair: the 7 faults of enrich-002 repaired by a third hand and re-read blind; see enrich-002/repair-*
done_check.caveat: cost is the harness's subagent_tokens per packet; enrich-002 ranker packets 1-3 completed but their agents were killed by a rate limit before reporting, so that phase is estimated from packets 4-5

done_check.instrument: .claude/agents/null-auditor.md, one question per sense; read as general-purpose on claude-fable-5-1 with the file read from disk
done_check.population: all 131 senses the enrich-002 Enricher marked null, in 6 blind packets (word, POS, gloss, book sentences - no learner line, no Enricher reasoning)
false_nulls: sister / fellow member of a group
mother / term of address for an elderly woman
lady / polite name for any woman
done_check.note: two of the three (mother, lady) were candidates in enrich-001 and null in enrich-002 - the Enricher's connotation call is unstable on address terms; the entry reader separately called young/vigorous a false null and the auditor upheld it, so the two instruments disagree there. All three false nulls plus young go to the family path as candidates.
done_check.stop_condition: not triggered: 2.3% is low; the Enricher keeps the connotation field

done_check.app_side: engine/Morphology.java names the relation from (query, headword, POS set); MorphologyTest asserts the same four words plus regular suffixes and irregular table; ./gradlew test green
